what.text: Survodutide (BI 456906) is an experimental injected peptide from Boehringer Ingelheim. It acts on two hormone receptors: glucagon and GLP-1. It is given once a week under the skin in trials.

research.text: Survodutide has been tested in randomized trials paid for by Boehringer Ingelheim. The main ones are listed below as they were run. The Phase 3 obesity program is called SYNCHRONIZE.

research.title: Phase 2: dose-finding in obesity

facts.v: randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled
387 adults aged 18 to 75 with a BMI of 27 or more, without diabetes
weekly survodutide 0.6, 2.4, 3.6 or 4.8 mg, or placebo
46 weeks (20 weeks of dose increases, 26 weeks at dose)
percent change in body weight

research.found: Weight changed by -6.2% to -14.9% on survodutide, depending on dose, and -2.8% on placebo. Only 60.4% finished the 46 weeks of treatment. Stomach and bowel side effects affected 75% on survodutide and 42% on placebo. ClinicalTrials.gov NCT04667377.

src.label: le Roux et al., survodutide phase 2 in obesity, Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol

research.title: SYNCHRONIZE-1: obesity without diabetes

facts.v: Phase 3, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled
725 adults with a BMI of 30 or more, or 27 or more with an obesity-related condition, no diabetes; 40.6% men; mean BMI 37.9
weekly survodutide up to 3.6 mg or 6.0 mg, or placebo, with lifestyle counseling
76 weeks
percent change in body weight; share losing at least 5%

research.found: Weight changed by -12.2% (3.6 mg), -13.0% (6.0 mg) and -5.4% (placebo). Stomach and bowel symptoms affected 80.9%, 89.7% and 47.9%. No deaths were reported. ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06066515.

src.label: le Roux et al., SYNCHRONIZE-1, N Engl J Med
SYNCHRONIZE-1 trial record, ClinicalTrials.gov

research.title: SYNCHRONIZE-2: obesity with type 2 diabetes

facts.v: Phase 3, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled
752 adults with type 2 diabetes and a BMI of 27 or more; mean age 55.7; 49.3% men
weekly survodutide 3.6 mg or 6.0 mg, or placebo
76 weeks
percent change in body weight; share losing at least 5%

research.found: Weight changed by -8.2% (3.6 mg), -9.8% (6.0 mg) and -3.9% (placebo). HbA1c fell by 0.9, 0.8 and 0.2 points from 7.4%. Stomach and bowel effects affected 72.8%, 77.7% and 38.6%. ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06066528.

src.label: Wharton et al., SYNCHRONIZE-2, N Engl J Med
SYNCHRONIZE-2 trial record, ClinicalTrials.gov

research.title: Phase 2: the liver disease MASH

facts.v: randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled; liver biopsies
293 adults with biopsy-confirmed MASH and liver scarring stage F1 to F3
weekly survodutide 2.4, 4.8 or 6.0 mg, or placebo
48 weeks
improvement in MASH on biopsy without worse scarring

research.found: MASH improved without worse scarring in 47%, 62% and 43% on the three doses and 14% on placebo. Nausea (66% vs 23%), diarrhea (49% vs 23%) and vomiting (41% vs 4%) were more common on survodutide. Serious side effects happened in 8% and 7%. ClinicalTrials.gov NCT04771273.

research.text: A heart-safety trial in about 5,500 people (SYNCHRONIZE-CVOT) reached its primary completion date in June 2026; its results were not found in a journal. Phase 3 MASH trials (LIVERAGE) are recruiting.

us.text: Survodutide is not FDA approved for any use. FDA has warned companies selling it "for research purposes". As of November 1, 2026.
Drugs@FDA has no record of an approved survodutide product.

items.text: FDA says it has warned companies that illegally sold unapproved drugs containing survodutide that were falsely labeled "for research purposes" or "not for human consumption". FDA says these were sold to consumers for human use with dosing instructions, are of unknown quality and may be harmful. FDA does not allow such products to be sold for human use.

after.text: Survodutide is not named on the WADA 2026 Prohibited List. The 2026 List's class S0 (non-approved substances) bans, at all times, any drug that is not covered by another section of the List and has no current approval from any government health regulator for human use. It names drugs still in clinical development as an example. The 2027 List keeps this class and adds peptides to its examples. The search found no approval for survodutide anywhere, so that class’s wording may cover it. WADA has not ruled on it.
